name: airbnb-disclosures
description: Check Airbnb cameras and noise monitors, and fix their listing disclosures. Use pasted inventories, listing descriptions and safety-field exports to find prohibited placements, missing camera locations and misleading noise wording. Get corrective actions and supported replacement text, including the narrow Japan entryway exception.
